later_events.mechanism: Recital by a later order (not an end): EO 11905 (41 FR 7703, signed 1976-02-18), subsection (f) of the section on the Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, states that the Board established by Executive Order No. 11460 of March 20, 1969, "remains in effect"; and its Oversight Board subsection says Oversight Board members may also serve on the Advisory Board. Neither revokes, amends or ends EO 11460.

Amendment of EO 11905 after EO 11984 (not an end of EO 11460): EO 11985 (42 FR 25487, signed 1977-05-13) deletes the words citing EO 11460 in paragraph (1) of subsection (a) and deletes subsection (f) of EO 11905; it neither revokes nor continues EO 11460.

research_rationale: EO 11460 (34 FR 5535, signed 1969-03-20) established the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board with four functions (section 1(1)-(4)), information access (2), appointed members (3), a staff (4), funding from appropriations (5) and revoked EO 10938 (6); it has no term or expiry. I read the full held text and corrected the dossier inventory (sections 2-4 were lumped into item (4); section 6 was missing). EO 11984 (42 FR 23129, signed 1977-05-04) revokes the whole order expressly and by number. Earlier endings checked: EO 11905 (1976) says the Board remains in effect (no end); EO 11985 (1977-05-13) postdates the revocation and only deletes references in EO 11905. No earlier revocation, supersession or own-terms end was found in the held texts cited here; the dossier carries no machine later-source search, so the search is limited to those held texts. Effective date of EO 11984 is taken as signing date 1977-05-04 (FR publication 1977-05-06 is the alternative reading). Working text is the held Federal Register OCR layer, not page-image verified.

savings.reason: EO 11984 is a single sentence revoking EO 11460 with no savings, transition or exception language, so no command of EO 11460 continues. Members and the Executive Secretary appointed under sections 3 and 4 held positions that ended with the Board; section 6's revocation of EO 10938 was performed in 1969 and is not undone. No held later order revives EO 11460: the held texts of EO 11905 and EO 11985 mention it only as described in later_events.
